signature.one_line: Frenetic name-drop podcast: accent divider pills, second accent name titles, one shot per word.
unique_devices: One-visual-per-word list montage: ~10-frame shots (0.4 s), one per spoken noun or word, peaking at ~130 cuts/min, then straight back to the speaker
Solid accent rounded pill behind 2-4 word white bold phrases at ~67 % H; on 50/50 splits the pill sits exactly on the divider line
second accent bold-italic serif name title with a dark outline appears on the cut to each named person in the hook, ~2x caption size at ~54-60 % H
Stacked split (b-roll top, speaker bottom) holds a long uncut answer while the top image swaps every ~4 s
signature.why_it_works: Recognisable faces land on the exact word, a money question opens the loop, and wildly uneven pacing (bursts vs long split holds) keeps attention shifting.

hook.type: social proof / name-drop + open loop question
hook.first_frame: Extreme close-up of a jewellery detail pulling out into a 50/50 split (guest top, host bottom) with the first caption on the divider

structure.what: name-drops with second accent name titles and archive/still b-roll, 7 cuts
host asks the money question (open loop)
long answer on a stacked split: b-roll top swapping every ~4 s, guest bottom; translucent name label
the real money comes from brand deals; press b-roll
montage of ~14 brand-ad shots at ~10 frames each, one per word
one clip per named person; ironic closing line
black end card: watch the full episode + thumbnail + link in bio

pacing.pace: frenetic and very uneven (~72 cuts/min hook, 0 during a long split hold, ~130 in the montage)

captions.what: white bold phrase on a solid accent rounded pill
captions.how: 2-4 words, one line, centred at 66.8 % H (pill 64.7-68.8 %); on 50/50 splits centred at 49.8 % on the divider; Inter 700 58 px, thin dark outline; pill 80 px tall, 18 px side padding, radius ~20 px; hard swap on the phrase's first word (+3 to +7 frames)

captions.what: plain white karaoke-opacity line over hook b-roll
captions.how: whole line at ~40 % opacity, each word steps to full white on its word; Inter 500 74 px, tracking 0.04em, centred at 59.6 % H, ~79 % W

captions.what: opening variant on a translucent amber box
captions.how: white words with a thin black outline on a soft-edged amber box (~70 %), words fading in, ~85 px

background_text.how: full name in bold italic semi-serif, second accent with slight vertical gradient to deeper orange, thin dark outline; centred at 54-60 % H, ~85 % W, ~91 px; optional second word in white serif fading in under it over ~10 frames

background_text.what: translucent large name label in the top split panel
background_text.how: large bold sans, white at ~55-60 % opacity, x 16-77 %, y 34.5-40 %

broll_inserts.how: ~10-frame shots, one per spoken noun, mid-sentence cuts; ads keep their own looks

broll_inserts.what: archive / still b-roll on each name and reference
broll_inserts.how: cut on the exact word the person or thing is named

layout.how: b-roll or guest top, speaker/host bottom, thin white divider; caption pill on the divider

camera.how: MCU heads; motion comes from cuts
zoom out from a detail ECU into the split over ~1 s

transitions.what: hard cuts mid-sentence on the noun
transitions.how: snap to the word being said

transitions.what: soft / fast-motion cuts inside b-roll runs

end_card.how: white bold caps 2 lines at centre y 24.6 %, ~64 % W; episode thumbnail with white border and rounded corners x 15.5-84.5 %, y 37-60 %, platform icon in a white circle on its bottom edge; 'LINK IN BIO' caps at 73.1 % H

case.pill: sentence case as spoken (capital only at sentence start / names)

grouping.sync: phrase-level: the whole phrase swaps in on its first word
grouping.break: at natural 2-4 word chunks and every comma

pill_on_50_50_split.note: pill sits exactly on the divider line between the two panels

layout.margins: symmetric; pill width = text + ~1.7 % W padding each side

pill.stroke: thin dark outline ~1.5 px at 1080 (#0B2A3A-ish, estimated)

plain.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, medium, slightly open spacing
plain.calibration_note: a 5-word lowercase line measured 3.28 % H / 78.8 % W over dark b-roll (words withheld)

animation.pill_entry: hard cut: pill and text swap in one frame, width jumps to the new phrase with no scale, fade or slide
animation.pill_timing: on the phrase's first word: typically +3 frames, up to ~+7 frames
animation.plain_entry: whole line visible at ~40 % opacity, each word steps to full white on its spoken word (karaoke opacity sweep, ~1 frame)
animation.hook_variant: first ~2 % on the split: lead words in white with a thin black outline on a translucent amber soft-edged box (~#C88A2A at ~70 %, estimated), words fading in; larger (~85 px, estimated)
animation.exit: hard cut on the next phrase or shot

other_text_spec.when: 2-5 % and 7-10 % of runtime, each named person on the cut
other_text_spec.text: 'Name Surname' in bold italic semi-serif (wedge serifs), gold #EFA816 with a slight vertical gradient to deeper orange, thin dark outline; centred, centre y 54-60 %, a 3-word name = ink 4.69 % H, 85 % W (k 0.99 -> ~91 px, estimated; closest match Playfair Display Italic 700, low confidence); an optional second word in white serif with dark shadow fades in under it over ~10 frames
'Name' in large bold sans, white at ~55-60 % opacity, x 16-77 %, y 34.5-40 % (cap height ~5.5 % H, estimated)

'WATCH FULL VIDEO / ON [PLATFORM]' white bold caps, 2 centred lines, cap height 2.73 % H each (k 0.73 -> ~72 px), block width 63.9 % W, centre y 24.6 %; episode thumbnail with white border + rounded corners x 15.5-84.5 %, y 37-60 % and a platform icon in a white circle on its bottom edge; 'LINK IN BIO' white bold caps, 2.66 % H (~70 px), 35 % W, centre y 73.1 %

style.look_intent: warm amber/tungsten studio, dark backgrounds, natural skin, mid contrast; inserted b-roll keeps its own bright looks

sound.music: music bed likely (gaps ~6 dB below speech), low and continuous under the voice
sfx: optional fast tick/whoosh per montage shot (inferred)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Stacked Split-Screen
catalog_styles.role: b-roll top / speaker bottom with the pill on the divider

catalog_styles.name: Sentence-by-Sentence Captions
catalog_styles.role: 2-4 word phrases in a cyan pill

use_when: A podcast or interview clip that names many people, brands or examples
There is (or can be sourced) b-roll for each noun to cut one shot per word
Two-camera footage that can run as a stacked split during long answers
The clip promotes a longer episode
avoid_when: No licensable b-roll for the named examples
A calm, single-idea talk where frenetic cutting would distract
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B13 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B13.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 25 fps. Two-camera podcast footage plus b-roll for every named example.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: white {{TEXT}} >= 4.5:1 on the {{ACCENT}} pill; {{ACCENT_2}} name titles >= 3:1 on the footage with their dark outline)
- {{TEXT}}: default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}: default #1590C5 (solid caption pill)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: default #EFA816 (name titles, gradient to a deeper orange)
- {{SURFACE}}: none (footage)
- {{CARD_BG}}: default #000000 (end card)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Playfair Display 700 italic (name titles)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Inter 700 (pill captions)
- {{HANDLE}}: default @handle (end card)
- {{LOGO}}: optional on the mics/set; platform icon on the end card

CAPTIONS
1. Latin, as spoken, sentence case; keep commas, full stops, question marks; no emoji.
2. 2-4 words per phrase, one line; break at commas.
3. {{FONT_BODY}} at 58 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking -0.01em, thin dark outline ~1.5 px, on a solid {{ACCENT}} rounded pill 80 px tall, 18 px side padding, radius ~20 px; pill hugs the text.
4. Single shots: centred, centre y 66.8 % H (pill 64.7-68.8 %). 50/50 splits: centre y 49.8 %, exactly on the divider.
5. Hard swap of pill + text in one frame on the phrase's first word (+0 to +3 frames); no scale/fade/slide; hard cut out.
6. Hook b-roll variant (~5-7 % of runtime): plain {{TEXT}} line, Inter 500 74 px, tracking 0.04em, centred at 59.6 % H, unspoken words at 40 % opacity stepping to full on their word. Very first ~2 %: lead words on a translucent soft-edged warm box (~70 %), ~85 px.

OTHER TEXT AND EDIT DEVICES
7. Name titles (hook only): on the cut to each named person, 'Name Surname' in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} ~91 px, {{ACCENT_2}} with a slight vertical gradient to a deeper orange, thin dark outline, centred at 54-60 % H, up to ~85 % W.
8. Long answers: stacked 50/50 split (b-roll top, speaker bottom), swap the top image every ~4 s; optional translucent large white 'Name' label (55-60 % opacity) at y 34.5-40 % in the top panel.
9. Lists of examples: one b-roll shot per spoken word, ~10 frames each, cut mid-sentence on the noun, then back to the speaker. Pacing deliberately uneven: bursts vs long split holds.
10. Open with a ~1 s pull-out from a detail ECU into the split; first word within ~1 frame.
11. End card (last ~4 % of runtime, ~50 frames): {{CARD_BG}}, 'WATCH FULL VIDEO / ON [PLATFORM]' white bold caps ~72 px at centre y 24.6 %, episode thumbnail with white border x 15.5-84.5 %, y 37-60 % with the platform icon on its bottom edge, 'LINK IN BIO' ~70 px at 73.1 % H.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: warm tungsten studio, dark backgrounds, natural skin; leave inserted b-roll in its own look.
SOUND: low music bed (~6 dB under speech gaps), zero silence, -14.3 LUFS; occasional hits on cuts.
